create_AffineStatsParallelAlgorithm: create an AffineStatsParallelAlgorithm instance to accumulate mean and variance online for a given tensor shape
run_AffineStatsParallelAlgorithm_forward: run the forward pass of AffineStatsParallelAlgorithm on a batch tensor to update and return mean and std
compute_compute_affine_stats: compute affine statistics for a dataset manifold by iterating over training batches across multiple epochs
get_get_affine_stats: get precomputed affine stats as torch tensors from a YAML file for a given dataset and manifold type
review_AffineStatsParallelAlgorithm_para: review the parallel algorithm method that merges batch statistics with accumulated mean and M2 using Welford-style updates
